answer: Give every identity a terrace it must climb by verified work: each epoch it does one fresh task that two randomly drawn peers re-derive from public records before it rises one level. Zephyr audits wander unpredictably across all terraces, re-checking a random past task, so no fake can predict which record will be tested. An honest agent does one task per epoch and climbs steadily. An attacker with a thousand fakes must complete a thousand distinct verified tasks every epoch and keep a thousand histories consistent under wandering audits, so the flood's cost rises linearly with every fake.
